title: Tableau Inactive Account Reclamation
dataSources: Tableau logs (`tableau:httpd`, `tableau:vizportal`, `tableau:backgrounder`), REST API, and `workgroup` repository tables via DB Connect.
app: Tableau Server logs via Universal Forwarder; Tableau Server REST API and TSM metrics via HEC; `workgroup` repository via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:httpd
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by user
| eval days_idle=round((now()-last_seen)/86400)
| where days_idle>60
| sort - days_idle
description: Lists Tableau accounts with no activity in over 60 days so administrators can reclaim licenses and reduce the access surface.
value: Idle Tableau accounts waste license spend and widen the attack surface; a periodic reclamation list turns both into routine housekeeping.
implementation: Ingest Tableau activity events; schedule monthly and route the idle-account list to identity/license owners.
visualization: Table of account by days idle, reclamation candidate list.
grandmaExplanation: We find Tableau accounts nobody uses anymore so their licences can be freed and access tidied up.
